lines: A carrot joke takes root <pulse>slowly</pulse>, if anyone lets it.
Farming jokes need timing. Mine usually arrive with soil on them.
I keep a spare joke near the fields. It is not always ready for public use.
I told a joke at the fields once. The workstation took it better than the villagers did.
Farmer jokes grow on you if the soil is willing.
I planted a joke last week. So far it is all setup.
A potato joke works best underground.
My wheat joke needs threshing before public use.
I told a carrot joke and everyone saw the root of it too early.
The scarecrow laughed once, but only because the wind helped.
A hoe joke is useful, even when it is not funny.
I tried a harvest joke. It took all season to land.
The field has a dry sense of humor during droughts.
A melon joke should never be forced. They split under pressure.
I told the compost a joke. It said everything comes around.
My best seed joke is still waiting for the right conditions.
A fence joke only works if it has good posts.
The rain told a joke today. The punchline was mud.
I asked the beetroot for advice. It just looked deeply rooted.
